reviewer: GPT-6 Astra / xhigh, main design reviewer
review_method: Read-only full paired draft, actual v3 C++/ABI and bound design/contracts; independently rehash all 15 evidence files and draft pair; rederive integer field widths, tree register/node count, edge schedule and resource arithmetic. No compiler, simulation, EDA or numerical oracle run.

accepted_design_requirements.arithmetic: 32 independent lanes, each 32 signed8 products and registered 17/18/19/20/21-bit fixed tree; independent I32/F32, scale FMUL, term FMUL and PS FADD. Preserve ascending g and each FP rounding; g0 starts +0 and still executes FADD. No FMA, reassociation or split accumulators.
accepted_design_requirements.half_decode: Fixed-latency bit decoder; normal/subnormal/zero/Inf/NaN sign/payload formula agrees with current loop decoder by source derivation. Exhaustive 65536-pattern equivalence is a future execution requirement, not yet an observed result.
accepted_design_requirements.bank_geometry: 8 Wq/Ws reads broadcast four rows; four A/As group entries broadcast eight columns; Aq/As address=(m0/4)*128+g, preserving actual fixed stride; 32 PS and 32 lane_bad banks; shape-gated read addresses avoid tail overrun.
accepted_design_requirements.lane_bad: Synchronous lane_bad cannot be known at issue. Reserve result/possible trace and set busy atomically before reads. Returned bad mask determines active mask, which remains aligned with all arithmetic/tag data. Extra shape-valid reads of previously bad lanes have no semantic MAC/PS/trace side effect.
accepted_design_requirements.nonstallable_return: Every issue owns one reserved result slot before entering arithmetic. Every all-masked, failing or canceled-trace vector still returns and commits exactly once. No trace/AXI condition may block fixed-latency arithmetic return.
accepted_design_requirements.queue_capacity: Q=pow2ceil(max(2,L_return+2)) accepted only for stated pre-edge return/commit/credit semantics and commit II1. Safety is credit-based independently of throughput. Added RAM read/commit/credit latency requires recalculation; payload bits/ports and resources must be measured.
accepted_design_requirements.PS_hazard: One in-flight vector per tile. Busy clears only at true PS/lane_bad/classification commit; no same-tile read during full following cycle. With issue e, return e+L, commit e+L+1, earliest same-tile issue e+L+3. Actual commit events govern all stalls, not an assumed fixed timer.
accepted_design_requirements.A_prefetch: Two 1152-bit data slots with valid/tag; copy selected A values into pipeline at issue and free only after last tile copies. Prefetch misses stall; no second full A8 cache or assumed hidden T1 latency.
accepted_design_requirements.trace: Reserve conservative shape-selected slot at issue. Return writes full intermediate payload while RESERVED; successful PS commit publishes READY, inactive/failing commit cancels. Ordered head retirement, B-response-based credit return and independent trace read/write port demand are explicit. Dtrace4 is finite safety candidate, not a speed promise.
accepted_design_requirements.error_semantics: Original phase0/1/2/3 classification, active failing current group still counts32 MAC, future groups skip bad lane. Global minimum tuple(tile,r,cc,g_or_G,phase) is equivalent to source rank, and 28-bit key has enough field widths. Keep original bad_element separately; preserve output side effects and minimum rank across all m0 including bias failures.
accepted_design_requirements.microblock: At every m0 boundary, drain arithmetic/results/trace and output responses before PS/lane_bad reuse. Initialize lane_bad only; g0 avoids stale PS read. Do not clear global first-rank at boundary.
accepted_design_requirements.quant: Full FP activation load precedes quant, original read-byte semantics retained. Eight finite-absmax lanes and eight multiply/round/pack services preserve actual /127, reciprocal, saved half RNE and roundf tie-away behavior. Whole group success required for Aq/As publish. First variant groups stay serial; hypothetical overlapped passes cannot be credited.
accepted_design_requirements.precision: Actual subnormal division/reciprocal/quant trace and smallest-F32 bias cases remain mandatory. C_HAS_UNDERFLOW is not FTZ proof. Expected tiny cases are source-derived requirements, not measured wrapper behavior.
accepted_design_requirements.completion_reset: Actual final report write responses retire before done; arithmetic/context/queue valid reset independently of payload. Preserve quiescent-only warm-reset scope; in-flight external response isolation requires separate platform contract.

remaining_measurements: Scorer actual source/observer packet and first three full-K/N command evidence
all new bank/FP/classification/store latencies and initiation intervals
actual 32-lane independent instance mapping and alignments
result/trace final widths, queue depths, RAM ports and physical mapping
actual PS memory read/write sampling edges
C1 numerical/protocol/recovery validation and same-source OOC resource/timing

resource_and_performance_scope.must_include: Full Q8 quant/strict restore/output, Attention/KV/other FP, shell/physical memory and Stage5 host transfers; root-assigned joint budget analysis remains separate.

authorization: This accepts the detailed candidate contract for later implementation review only. No implementation, materializer, CPU/CSim, HLS, RTL, OOC or board execution is released. First full-K/N Scorer pilot remains the next evidence gate; no unchanged ACT36 or Attention cold4 rerun.
current_document_policy: This new independent review does not mutate the frozen draft pair or its source evidence. Current M/source/design.md remains unchanged until the post-Scorer implementation selection.
